message.content: {"thought": "The critical path ends at 10.58s on core5 with layer0_norm2 (memory/communication-bound). The critical-path tail layers (norm2, res2, GeLU, res1) are memory/communication-bound with 50-59% memory time and 40-56% communication time. The low core utilization (45.5%) suggests that increasing compute parallelism (more chiplets) would not help much since many cores are already idle. The critical-path tail is driven by memory and communication bottlenecks. I should examine the detailed layer loads to understand whether DRAM BW or NoP BW is the more impactful constraint for the critical-path layers.
